app.name: Halo CE Wii
app.long_description:
Unofficial Homebrew Channel stub for a future Halo: Combat Evolved engine port.
This build lists your cache files, draws the first structure BSP with a lightmap or bitmap from that cache on GX, and runs OpenCE game_tick. Script special forms execute. players.c, units, weapons, and ai.c are linked. A biped is spawned at the first player start from a stand-in tag, not from the map's cyborg tag. No game data is included.
Not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios, Halo Studios, Activision, or Bungie. JojoXDK's private Wii work in progress is a different project and is not included here.
Stub no oficial del canal Homebrew. No es jugable y no incluye datos del juego. HOME sale al loader.
